provenance.explanation: The T21R4/T21R5 validation commits (fbe034a, da044e4) re-recorded several of their own post-freeze artifacts after their holdout freeze manifests were written: evaluations/t21r4/runtime_freeze.json, evaluations/t21r4/holdout_uniqueness.json, scripts/t21r4_freeze_evaluator.py, evaluations/t21r5/runtime_freeze.json and evaluations/t21r5/holdout_uniqueness.json, in the same post-freeze re-record pattern as the originally pinned scripts/t21r4_run_eval.py. Every mismatched file is byte-identical to the canonical base f71cdb6e (mechanically re-verified by scripts/t21r6_extend_debt_ledger.py via git cat-file against the base blob), so the mismatches pre-date T21R6, are inherited from the canonical base, and are NOT new R6 corruption. T21R4/T21R5 history is NOT rewritten; the ledger only grows inside evaluations/t21r6/.
